name: VerticalTabNav
description:
Route navigation for sections, with an active location indicator and a responsive rail. Links in a `<nav>`, the
current one with `aria-current="page"`; one row is tabbable and the arrow keys (↑ ↓ in the
rail, ← → as tabs), Home / End and Space behave as in `VerticalTabs`. In a narrow container
it becomes `TabNav`'s horizontal strip, whose More menu rows are links. Router-agnostic:
`RouteVerticalTabs` adapts it.
signature: <T extends VerticalTabItem>({ items, value, renderLink, layout: forced, className, children, "aria-label": label }: VerticalTabNavProps<T>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: items
props.description: The collection rendered by the component. Stable identifiers preserve selection and keyboard focus.

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Renders a link with the host router.

props.name: value
props.description: The active section's value — derived from the location by the route adapter.
